title: Authenticated Actor Context
description: Transport-neutral identity context produced by Auth and carried from Gateway to Agent Loop. It contains no credentials or permissions. The receiving boundary must verify the caller before trusting it; headers, body fields, direct-call arguments, and other transports are adapters for this shape.

actor.description: The authenticated actor. Auth remains authoritative for current status and permissions.

authentication_id.description: Stable identifier for this authenticated request/session, not a secret credential.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry for the authentication context. The receiving boundary rejects an expired context.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end request correlation ID shared with Gateway, Agent Loop, Auth, tools, and audit records.
